items.control_name: Enforce Private Endpoints & Disable Public Network Access on Azure OpenAI
items.description: Azure OpenAI instances must disable public network access (publicNetworkAccess=Disabled) and communicate exclusively via Private Endpoints.
items.current_value: All 4 Azure OpenAI resources use Private Endpoints with publicNetworkAccess=Disabled
items.recommended_value: 100% Private Endpoints; Public Network Access = Disabled
items.remediation_notes: Verify DNS integration with Private DNS Zone 'privatelink.openai.azure.com'.

items.control_name: Enforce Azure AI Content Safety Filters against Prompt Injection & Jailbreaks
items.description: Azure OpenAI deployments must attach an AI Content Safety filter configured to block hate speech, jailbreaks, and prompt injection attempts.
items.current_value: Filter 'content-safety-strict' attached to production LLM deployments
items.recommended_value: AI Content Safety filter active on all model deployments
items.remediation_notes: Regularly review Content Safety block logs in Log Analytics.

items.control_name: Enforce Customer Managed Key (CMK) Encryption on Azure ML Workspaces
items.description: Azure Machine Learning workspaces must use Key Vault Customer Managed Keys to encrypt training metrics, datasets, and notebooks.
items.current_value: CMK encryption active on workspace 'ml-prod-workspace'; Microsoft-managed key on 'ml-dev'
items.recommended_value: Customer Managed Key (CMK) enforced across all ML workspaces
items.remediation_notes: Enable Key Vault CMK encryption on 'ml-dev' workspace.

items.control_name: Enforce Managed Virtual Network Isolation for Azure ML Compute
items.description: Azure Machine Learning compute instances and clusters must deploy behind a Managed Virtual Network with outbound FQDN rules.
items.current_value: Managed Virtual Network = 'AllowOnlyApprovedOutbound' on 100% of ML compute
items.recommended_value: Managed VNet Isolation enabled with restricted outbound rules
items.remediation_notes: Audit custom FQDN outbound exceptions monthly.
